target: median execution-length slope in ms per call
fitting: R2 only; family models; per-thread baseline and paired ratio
selection: leave one shape group out; retain all threads and arms in each held-out group
selection_loss: mean group maximum absolute log error across baseline, candidate and ratio
calibration_score: group maximum absolute log error across baseline, candidate and ratio, both thread counts
claim_scope: fixed binaries, controlled hot repeated inputs, predeclared shape grids
training_choice_reason: R1 uses a different measurement binary; calibration and tests reuse the exact R2 binaries
